s0001.literal: Second year, spring, first month, on jichou day, at the crown prince's request, the crown prince's tutorate was abolished; guests, instructors, and assistants were established as before.
s0001.idiomatic: Second year, spring, first month, on jichou day, at the crown prince's request, the crown prince's tutorate was abolished; guests, instructors, and assistants were established as before.

s0002.literal: On gengyin day Prince Tula of Yue, having committed a crime, was granted death.
s0002.idiomatic: On gengyin day Prince Tula of Yue, having committed a crime, was granted death.

s0003.literal: Day diviners and recipe masters were forbidden to enter the gates of princes, princesses, close attendants, and other officials.
s0003.idiomatic: Day diviners and recipe masters were forbidden to enter the gates of princes, princesses, close attendants, and other officials.

s0004.literal: On xinmao day the crown prince, princes, and all officials presented the honorific title Emperor of Harmonizing Heaven, Continuing the Sage, Revering Culture, Martial and Civil in Great Splendor, and Great Filial Brightness.
s0004.idiomatic: On xinmao day the crown prince, princes, and all officials presented the honorific title Emperor of Harmonizing Heaven, Continuing the Sage, Revering Culture, Martial and Civil in Great Splendor, and Great Filial Brightness.

s0005.literal: On yiwei day sacrificial thanks were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0005.idiomatic: On yiwei day sacrificial thanks were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0006.literal: On bingshen day an edict ordered the realm to relax prohibitions on mountains and marshes, succor the displaced, and not require registered households to pay corvée taxes on behalf of absentees;
s0006.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict ordered the realm to relax prohibitions on mountains and marshes, succor the displaced, and not require registered households to pay corvée taxes on behalf of absentees;

s0007.literal: commoners in disaster areas — inner circuits were exempt from corvée taxes for one year, Jianghuai was exempt from summer tax;
s0007.idiomatic: commoners in disaster areas — inner circuits were exempt from corvée taxes for one year, Jianghuai was exempt from summer tax;

s0008.literal: all civil and military officials at every level were granted one grade of nominal rank; those with formal appointments who had completed their term of service were given one additional grade of nominal rank.
s0008.idiomatic: all civil and military officials at every level were granted one grade of nominal rank; those with formal appointments who had completed their term of service were given one additional grade of nominal rank.

s0009.literal: On jihai day Chuangwu'er, Duke of Rong State and privy council administrator, was enfeoffed Prince of Jurong Commandery.
s0009.idiomatic: On jihai day Chuangwu'er, Duke of Rong State and privy council administrator, was enfeoffed Prince of Jurong Commandery.

s0010.literal: On yisi day Tashihwa and Chigai Puji said: "People relying on grace memorialize directly; imperial letters not passing through the central secretariat but issued straight from the Hanlin academy — having now tallied their number, from the sixth year of Dade through the first year of Zhida, more than six thousand three hundred were issued, all concerning land, households, gold and silver, ironworks, surplus tax quotas, tribute of rare goods, grain funds, selection law, litigation, construction, and other matters — harming the people. We request that all be revoked and recovered.
s0010.idiomatic: On yisi day Tashihwa and Chigai Puji said, "People relying on grace memorialize directly; imperial letters not passing through the central secretariat but issued straight from the Hanlin academy — having now tallied their number, from the sixth year of Dade through the first year of Zhida, more than 6,300 were issued, all concerning land, households, gold and silver, ironworks, surplus tax quotas, tribute of rare goods, grain funds, selection law, litigation, construction, and other matters — harming the people. We request that all be revoked and recovered.

s0011.literal: From now on, for those not passing through the central secretariat, we request that none be granted.
s0011.idiomatic: From now on, for those not passing through the central secretariat, we request that none be granted.

s0013.literal: On bingwu day regulations were fixed that the spring and autumn libation sacrifices to the Great Completion Sage Master of Culture use the grand offering.
s0013.idiomatic: On bingwu day regulations were fixed that the spring and autumn libation sacrifices to the Great Completion Sage Master of Culture use the grand offering.

s0014.literal: On wushen day Dieli Temür Buqa presented hawks and hunting dogs; an order directed that each year he be given one thousand bolts of silks and cloths and one thousand ingots of notes.
s0014.idiomatic: On wushen day Dieli Temür Buqa presented hawks and hunting dogs; an order directed that each year he be given 1,000 bolts of silks and cloths and 1,000 ingots of notes.

s0015.literal: Second month, on wuwu day a gold seal was cast and granted to Prince of Jurong Commandery Chuangwu'er.
s0015.idiomatic: Second month, on wuwu day a gold seal was cast and granted to Prince of Jurong Commandery Chuangwu'er.

s0016.literal: Famine victims of Zhending Route were relieved with ten thousand shi of grain; the Tatar frontier with six thousand shi.
s0016.idiomatic: Famine victims of Zhending Route were relieved with 10,000 shi of grain; the Tatar frontier with 6,000 shi.

s0017.literal: On guihai day the crown prince visited the Buddhist monasteries of Mount Wutai.
s0017.idiomatic: On guihai day the crown prince visited the Buddhist monasteries of Mount Wutai.

s0018.literal: The Quanfu Court was abolished; maritime trade was returned to branch secretariats.
s0018.idiomatic: The Quanfu Court was abolished; maritime trade was returned to branch secretariats.

s0019.literal: On yichou day because Karakorum garrison-farm fields yielded more than ninety thousand shi at autumn harvest, the pacification commission officials, platoon commanders, and soldiers were rewarded in varying amounts.
s0019.idiomatic: On yichou day because Karakorum garrison-farm fields yielded more than 90,000 shi at autumn harvest, the pacification commission officials, platoon commanders, and soldiers were rewarded in varying amounts.

s0020.literal: On jisi day the moon encroached upon Kui.
s0020.idiomatic: On jisi day the moon encroached upon Kui.

s0021.literal: On xinwei day the moon encroached upon Di.
s0021.idiomatic: On xinwei day the moon encroached upon Di.

s0022.literal: Nine thousand five hundred troops of princes' divisions and the armies of Quliqache, Urudai, and Duolai were mobilized to proceed to Karakorum.
s0022.idiomatic: 9,500 troops of princes' divisions and the armies of Quliqache, Urudai, and Duolai were mobilized to proceed to Karakorum.

s0023.literal: On renshen day an order directed that garrison-farm officers of each guard rotate every three years.
s0023.idiomatic: On renshen day an order directed that garrison-farm officers of each guard rotate every three years.

s0024.literal: On jiaxu day the wine prohibition in the Central Capital was relaxed.
s0024.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the wine prohibition in the Central Capital was relaxed.

s0025.literal: Third month, on jichou day Hong Chongxi, right vice director of the Liaoyang branch secretariat, accused King Wang Jang of Koryo of not obeying the laws of the state and acting with wanton violence, and other matters; central secretariat officials requested that Chongxi and the King of Koryo be ordered to argue face to face.
s0025.idiomatic: Third month, on jichou day Hong Chongxi, right vice director of the Liaoyang branch secretariat, accused King Wang Jang of Koryo of not obeying the laws of the state and acting with wanton violence, and other matters; central secretariat officials requested that Chongxi and the King of Koryo be ordered to argue face to face.

s0026.literal: An edict directed the central secretariat not to order a face-to-face argument, but ordered the King of Koryo to follow the empress dowager to Mount Wutai.
s0026.idiomatic: An edict directed the central secretariat not to order a face-to-face argument, but ordered the King of Koryo to follow the empress dowager to Mount Wutai.

s0027.literal: The Prince of Liang residing in Yunnan had wind illness; Prince Laodi was sent to replace the Prince of Liang in governing Yunnan, granted two hundred fifty taels of gold and seven hundred fifty taels of silver, and followers granted silks and cloths in varying amounts.
s0027.idiomatic: The Prince of Liang residing in Yunnan had wind illness; Prince Laodi was sent to replace the Prince of Liang in governing Yunnan, granted 250 taels of gold and 750 taels of silver, and followers granted silks and cloths in varying amounts.

s0028.literal: On gengyin day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.
s0028.idiomatic: On gengyin day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.

s0029.literal: Fifty soldiers from the five guards were detached and assigned to the Central Capital Tiger Guard Office; Prince Yeshi Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Xiangning.
s0029.idiomatic: 50 soldiers from the five guards were detached and assigned to the Central Capital Tiger Guard Office; Prince Yeshi Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Xiangning.

s0030.literal: On xinmao day the Hangzhou Baiyun sect administrative office was abolished, and the Huguang Head Monk-Chan Record Office was established.
s0030.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Hangzhou Baiyun sect administrative office was abolished, and the Huguang Head Monk-Chan Record Office was established.

s0031.literal: On bingyin day Prince Laodi of Yunnan was granted a gold seal.
s0031.idiomatic: On bingyin day Prince Laodi of Yunnan was granted a gold seal.

s0032.literal: On wuxu day the moon encroached upon Di.
s0032.idiomatic: On wuxu day the moon encroached upon Di.

s0033.literal: On jihai day Mars encroached upon Jupiter.
s0033.idiomatic: On jihai day Mars encroached upon Jupiter.

s0034.literal: Princess Aradnabal was enfeoffed Grand Princess of Zhao State, and imperial son-in-law Zhu'an was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao.
s0034.idiomatic: Princess Aradnabal was enfeoffed Grand Princess of Zhao State, and imperial son-in-law Zhu'an was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao.

s0035.literal: On jiachen day central secretariat officials said: "State annual levies have fixed quotas; recently because of years of famine revenue once fell to less than half, while last year's expenditures reached ten million ingots of notes and three million shi of grain.
s0035.idiomatic: On jiachen day central secretariat officials said, "State annual levies have fixed quotas; recently because of years of famine revenue once fell to less than half, while last year's expenditures reached 10 million ingots of notes and 3 million shi of grain.

s0036.literal: Your Majesty once ordered reduction of those seeking fodder and grain, yet Lekesun of the Bureau of Palace Provisions ultimately could not implement it; compared with last year it increased by three hundred thousand shi instead — we request that two or three persons versed in money and grain affairs be placed in the Bureau of Palace Provisions to assist in management."
s0036.idiomatic: Your Majesty once ordered reduction of those seeking fodder and grain, yet Lekesun of the Bureau of Palace Provisions ultimately could not implement it; compared with last year it increased by 300,000 shi instead — we request that two or three persons versed in money and grain affairs be placed in the Bureau of Palace Provisions to assist in management."

s0037.literal: Also, central secretariat adjudication officials: in the tenth year of Dade forty-three positions; now the crown prince's establishment added two, Prince Kuokuochu and imperial son-in-law Gantula each also added one — not the old system.
s0037.idiomatic: Also, central secretariat adjudication officials: in the tenth year of Dade 43 positions; now the crown prince's establishment added two, Prince Kuokuochu and imperial son-in-law Gantula each also added one — not the old system.

s0038.literal: We your ministers consider that those added to the crown prince's establishment should remain; those added for princes should be abolished."
s0038.idiomatic: We your ministers consider that those added to the crown prince's establishment should remain; those added for princes should be abolished."

s0040.literal: The Medical Superintendent Office was elevated to the Directorate of Medicine.
s0040.idiomatic: The Medical Superintendent Office was elevated to the Directorate of Medicine.

s0041.literal: On yisi day central secretariat officials said: "The central secretariat is head of all offices; redundant personnel should first be trimmed.
s0041.idiomatic: On yisi day central secretariat officials said, "The central secretariat is head of all offices; redundant personnel should first be trimmed.

s0042.literal: The Emperor said: "For all offices that are trimmed, you are to fix the deliberation;
s0042.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "For all offices that are trimmed, you are to fix the deliberation;

s0043.literal: as for which secretariat officials stay or go, We shall consider it Ourselves."
s0043.idiomatic: as for which secretariat officials stay or go, We shall consider it Ourselves."

s0044.literal: On jiyou day Jiyin, Dingtao, and other places suffered hail.
s0044.idiomatic: On jiyou day Jiyin, Dingtao, and other places suffered hail.

s0045.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiayin day central secretariat officials said: "At the Jiang-Zhe Hangzhou relay station, within half a year more than one thousand two hundred envoys passed through; Sangwu, Baoheding, and others presented lions, leopards, crows, and falcons, staying twenty-seven days, and men and beasts consumed more than one thousand three hundred jin of meat.
s0045.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on jiayin day central secretariat officials said, "At the Jiang-Zhe Hangzhou relay station, within half a year more than 1,200 envoys passed through; Sangwu, Baoheding, and others presented lions, leopards, crows, and falcons, staying 27 days, and men and beasts consumed more than 1,300 jin of meat.

s0046.literal: We request that from now on those coming from distant regions with rare beasts and exotic treasures follow the relay system;
s0046.idiomatic: We request that from now on those coming from distant regions with rare beasts and exotic treasures follow the relay system;

s0047.literal: for merchants who happen to have something to present, let them supply their own expenses."
s0047.idiomatic: for merchants who happen to have something to present, let them supply their own expenses."

s0049.literal: On xinyou day the Xingsheng Palace Jianghuai Finance Chief Commission was established; an edict announced it throughout inner and outer domains.
s0049.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Xingsheng Palace Jianghuai Finance Chief Commission was established; an edict announced it throughout inner and outer domains.

s0050.literal: On guihai day five thousand Han troops were detached, granted one hundred thousand qing of fields, and garrison-farmed at the coastal mouth of Zhigu; two thousand Khorchi troops were added, and the Garrison and Storage Elite Army Command of Haikou was established.
s0050.idiomatic: On guihai day 5,000 Han troops were detached, granted 100,000 qing of fields, and garrison-farmed at the coastal mouth of Zhigu; 2,000 Khorchi troops were added, and the Garrison and Storage Elite Army Command of Haikou was established.

s0051.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered construction of corner towers for the Central Capital's inner city wall.
s0051.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered construction of corner towers for the Central Capital's inner city wall.

s0052.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Now farming is at its busiest, locust nymphs cover the fields, and the people lack food — we request that corvée be halted according to the previous order.
s0052.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Now farming is at its busiest, locust nymphs cover the fields, and the people lack food — we request that corvée be halted according to the previous order.

s0053.literal: The Emperor said: "If the inner city wall has no corner towers, how can it be a grand sight!
s0053.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "If the inner city wall has no corner towers, how can it be a grand sight!

s0054.literal: Finish this work first; the rest may wait."
s0054.idiomatic: Finish this work first; the rest may wait."

s0055.literal: For construction of the new monastery, silver seals of third rank for supervisor and construction overseer were cast.
s0055.idiomatic: For construction of the new monastery, silver seals of third rank for supervisor and construction overseer were cast.

s0056.literal: Yidu, Dongping, Dongchang, Jining, Hejian, Shunde, Guangping, Daming, Bianliang, Weihui, Tai'an, Gaotang, Cao, Pu, De, Yang, Chu, Gaoyou, and other places suffered locusts.
s0056.idiomatic: Yidu, Dongping, Dongchang, Jining, Hejian, Shunde, Guangping, Daming, Bianliang, Weihui, Tai'an, Gaotang, Cao, Pu, De, Yang, Chu, Gaoyou, and other places suffered locusts.

s0057.literal: Fifth month, on dinghai day Hanlaher, communications commissioner, was made privy council administrator and put in charge of building the Xingsheng Palace; Dadu resident Yang'an and others were ordered to supervise the work.
s0057.idiomatic: Fifth month, on dinghai day Hanlaher, communications commissioner, was made privy council administrator and put in charge of building the Xingsheng Palace; Dadu resident Yang'an and others were ordered to supervise the work.

s0058.literal: On dingyou day, because yin-yang masters said that from now until the Sage's birthday earthworks were inauspicious, an edict temporarily halted corvée on the new monastery.
s0058.idiomatic: On dingyou day, because yin-yang masters said that from now until the Sage's birthday earthworks were inauspicious, an edict temporarily halted corvée on the new monastery.

s0059.literal: On jiachen day censorate officials said: "While the imperial carriage travels north, capital corvée is in full swing; moreover drought and food shortage afflict the year — the people are easily misled, and the matter is extremely grave — we request that one chancellor remain to guard the capital, and that this become precedent.
s0059.idiomatic: On jiachen day censorate officials said, "While the imperial carriage travels north, capital corvée is in full swing; moreover drought and food shortage afflict the year — the people are easily misled, and the matter is extremely grave — we request that one chancellor remain to guard the capital, and that this become precedent.

s0061.literal: Sixth month, on guihai day officials were selected to supervise locust extermination.
s0061.idiomatic: Sixth month, on guihai day officials were selected to supervise locust extermination.

s0062.literal: At the crown prince's word, those granted fields were forbidden to ride relay posts to collect rent and harass the people.
s0062.idiomatic: At the crown prince's word, those granted fields were forbidden to ride relay posts to collect rent and harass the people.

s0063.literal: On gengwu day central secretariat officials said: "Since the order has already halted corvée on the new monastery, the pavilion gardens, falconry offices, and other corvée — we request that all be abolished as well.
s0063.idiomatic: On gengwu day central secretariat officials said, "Since the order has already halted corvée on the new monastery, the pavilion gardens, falconry offices, and other corvée — we request that all be abolished as well.

s0064.literal: Also, the Imperial Medical Academy dispatches envoys to obtain medicinal materials in Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Yunnan, expending public funds and exhausting relay transport.
s0064.idiomatic: Also, the Imperial Medical Academy dispatches envoys to obtain medicinal materials in Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Yunnan, expending public funds and exhausting relay transport.

s0065.literal: We your ministers consider that matters touching money and grain, bypassing the central secretariat and acting directly — we request that this be forbidden."
s0065.idiomatic: We your ministers consider that matters touching money and grain, bypassing the central secretariat and acting directly — we request that this be forbidden."

s0067.literal: Yidu, Jinan, and Panyang routes and Ninghai Prefecture were placed under the pacification commission; the remainder were all ordered to report directly to the provincial offices.
s0067.idiomatic: Yidu, Jinan, and Panyang routes and Ninghai Prefecture were placed under the pacification commission; the remainder were all ordered to report directly to the provincial offices.

s0068.literal: Forty households registered as Confucian scholars in the Great Capital were assigned as temple musicians for the Confucian shrine.
s0068.idiomatic: 40 households registered as Confucian scholars in the Great Capital were assigned as temple musicians for the Confucian shrine.

s0069.literal: At the crown prince's request, the director, commissioner, and other officials of the Directorate of Music were changed to director, vice director, and assistant director.
s0069.idiomatic: At the crown prince's request, the director, commissioner, and other officials of the Directorate of Music were changed to director, vice director, and assistant director.

s0070.literal: On jiaxu day, because palace guards had grown excessively numerous and mixed, following the old system, only Mongols and semuren of distinguished lineage were retained; the rest were all removed.
s0070.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, because palace guards had grown excessively numerous and mixed, following the old system, only Mongols and semuren of distinguished lineage were retained; the rest were all removed.

s0071.literal: The crown prince said: "The Xuanzheng Bureau earlier received an order that those who beat Tibetan monks should have their hands cut off and those who revile them their tongues cut out — this law has never been heard of before; it violates the laws of the state and moreover does the monks no good.
s0071.idiomatic: The crown prince said, "The Xuanzheng Bureau earlier received an order that those who beat Tibetan monks should have their hands cut off and those who revile them their tongues cut out — this law has never been heard of before; it violates the laws of the state and moreover does the monks no good.

s0072.literal: When monks and laymen offend one another, there are already clear statutes — we request that the order be changed.
s0072.idiomatic: When monks and laymen offend one another, there are already clear statutes — we request that the order be changed.

s0073.literal: He also said: "The Xuanzheng Bureau does not examine documents — this obstructs the laws and regulations; following the old system would be fitting."
s0073.idiomatic: He also said, "The Xuanzheng Bureau does not examine documents — this obstructs the laws and regulations; following the old system would be fitting."

s0075.literal: On yihai day central secretariat officials said: "Henan and Jiang-Zhe provinces report that the Xuanzheng Bureau memorialized exemption of monks, Daoists, Nestorian Christians, and Dashman from land rent and commercial tax.
s0075.idiomatic: On yihai day central secretariat officials said, "Henan and Jiang-Zhe provinces report that the Xuanzheng Bureau memorialized exemption of monks, Daoists, Nestorian Christians, and Dashman from land rent and commercial tax.

s0076.literal: We your ministers consider that fields pay rent and merchants pay tax — this is the established law of the ancestors; now the Xuanzheng Bureau memorializes blanket exemption — this is not the system.
s0076.idiomatic: We your ministers consider that fields pay rent and merchants pay tax — this is the established law of the ancestors; now the Xuanzheng Bureau memorializes blanket exemption — this is not the system.

s0077.literal: An order stated that collection should follow the old system.
s0077.idiomatic: An order stated that collection should follow the old system.

s0078.literal: That month, Jincheng, Guo Prefecture, and Yuan Prefecture suffered rain and hail; Shenmu, Panxi, Shenchuan, and other places in Yan'an suffered heavy hail; Bazhou, Tanzhou, Zhuozhou, Liangxiang, Shucheng, Liyang, Hefei, Lu'an, Jiangning, Jurong, Lishui, Shangyuan, and other places suffered locusts.
s0078.idiomatic: That month, Jincheng, Guo Prefecture, and Yuan Prefecture suffered rain and hail; Shenmu, Panxi, Shenchuan, and other places in Yan'an suffered heavy hail; Bazhou, Tanzhou, Zhuozhou, Liangxiang, Shucheng, Liyang, Hefei, Lu'an, Jiangning, Jurong, Lishui, Shangyuan, and other places suffered locusts.

s0079.literal: Seventh month, autumn, on guiwei day the Yellow River burst its banks in Guide Prefecture.
s0079.idiomatic: Seventh month, autumn, on guiwei day the Yellow River burst its banks in Guide Prefecture.

s0080.literal: On renchen day Xuanzheng Bureau officials said: "Prince of Wujing Sosban and Duosima, director of the pacification commission, report: 'Within the jurisdiction of the Pacification Commission of Songpan, Diezhang, Weimao Prefecture, and other places, Tibetans, Tuluobu, surrendered Hu, and Han commoners of four kinds of people live mixed together. Recently Commissioner Cai Maozhao was sent to Shegu Longmi to summon them; eight tribes submitted, seventeen thousand households — all people who had stubbornly resisted for centuries; chieftains Lingzhenba and eight others have already had audience at court.
s0080.idiomatic: On renchen day Xuanzheng Bureau officials said, "Prince of Wujing Sosban and Duosima, director of the pacification commission, report, 'Within the jurisdiction of the Pacification Commission of Songpan, Diezhang, Weimao Prefecture, and other places, Tibetans, Tuluobu, surrendered Hu, and Han commoners of four kinds of people live mixed together. Recently Commissioner Cai Maozhao was sent to Shegu Longmi to summon them; eight tribes submitted, 17,000 households — all people who had stubbornly resisted for centuries; chieftains Lingzhenba and eight others have already had audience at court.

s0081.literal: Now Lingzhenba says their land adjoins Sichuan, and those not yet submitted still number more than one hundred thousand.
s0081.idiomatic: Now Lingzhenba says their land adjoins Sichuan, and those not yet submitted still number more than 100,000.

s0082.literal: Pacification commission officials are all men from other commanderies and do not understand barbarian affairs; they reach Chengdu and Guan Prefecture and return at once from fear — how can they govern and pacify?
s0082.idiomatic: Pacification commission officials are all men from other commanderies and do not understand barbarian affairs; they reach Chengdu and Guan Prefecture and return at once from fear — how can they govern and pacify?

s0083.literal: It would be fitting to change the Pacification Commission to a Pacification Office, relocate its seat to Maozhou, and move one thousand Songzhou troops to garrison and restrain them.'
s0083.idiomatic: It would be fitting to change the Pacification Commission to a Pacification Office, relocate its seat to Maozhou, and move 1,000 Songzhou troops to garrison and restrain them.'

s0084.literal: ' We your ministers consider that their proposal should be followed.
s0084.idiomatic: ' We your ministers consider that their proposal should be followed.

s0085.literal: An edict changed the Pacification Commission of Songpan, Diezhang, and Weimao Prefecture to a Pacification Office, relocated its seat to Wenchuan County in Maozhou, rank primary third grade; Ba'rsidjin was made darughachi of the Pacification Office, Cai Maozhao vice commissioner — both granted tiger tallies.
s0085.idiomatic: An edict changed the Pacification Commission of Songpan, Diezhang, and Weimao Prefecture to a Pacification Office, relocated its seat to Wenchuan County in Maozhou, rank primary third grade; Ba'rsidjin was made darughachi of the Pacification Office, Cai Maozhao vice commissioner — both granted tiger tallies.

s0086.literal: On yiwei day Longnan and Anyuan counties in Gan Prefecture were restored.
s0086.idiomatic: On yiwei day Longnan and Anyuan counties in Gan Prefecture were restored.

s0087.literal: Because the twenty relay stations of Hexi saw many passing envoys while horses were few and the people's strength was exhausted, the central secretariat, privy council, and Communications Office were ordered to allocate households from various divisions to increase horses and supply the need.
s0087.idiomatic: Because the 20 relay stations of Hexi saw many passing envoys while horses were few and the people's strength was exhausted, the central secretariat, privy council, and Communications Office were ordered to allocate households from various divisions to increase horses and supply the need.

s0088.literal: Leshi said the paper-note system was greatly corrupted and requested reform of the note law; he drew a new note design and presented it, and also with Ba'ba deliberated establishing the Ministry of Revenue; an edict ordered Chigai Puji, Tashihwa, Chiyin Temur, and Toghto to assemble in deliberation and report.
s0088.idiomatic: Leshi said the paper-note system was greatly corrupted and requested reform of the note law; he drew a new note design and presented it, and also with Ba'ba deliberated establishing the Ministry of Revenue; an edict ordered Chigai Puji, Tashihwa, Chiyin Temur, and Toghto to assemble in deliberation and report.

s0089.literal: On jihai day the Yellow River burst its banks at Fengqiu in Bianliang.
s0089.idiomatic: On jihai day the Yellow River burst its banks at Fengqiu in Bianliang.

s0090.literal: On jiachen day the Chief Commandery of Xibaozhibalhesun was changed to the Fengshi Court.
s0090.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Chief Commandery of Xibaozhibalhesun was changed to the Fengshi Court.

s0091.literal: On yisi day Ba'ba said: "Your subject together with Tashihwa, Chigai Puji, and others assembled in deliberation on establishing the Ministry of Revenue; your subject now reflects privately — the gains and losses of government all stem from what the central secretariat officials did the day before; now if we wish to set things right, they fear being implicated — who would be willing to act?
s0091.idiomatic: On yisi day Ba'ba said, "Your subject together with Tashihwa, Chigai Puji, and others assembled in deliberation on establishing the Ministry of Revenue; your subject now reflects privately — the gains and losses of government all stem from what the central secretariat officials did the day before; now if we wish to set things right, they fear being implicated — who would be willing to act?

s0092.literal: If your subject now remains silent, it is truly from fear of great affairs.
s0092.idiomatic: If your subject now remains silent, it is truly from fear of great affairs.

s0093.literal: If Your Majesty would show compassion for what Ba'ba and Leshi propose, we request establishment of the Ministry of Revenue — old affairs handled by the central secretariat, new policies by the Ministry of Revenue.
s0093.idiomatic: If Your Majesty would show compassion for what Ba'ba and Leshi propose, we request establishment of the Ministry of Revenue — old affairs handled by the central secretariat, new policies by the Ministry of Revenue.

s0094.literal: For the Ministry of Revenue, we request Chigai Puji and Toghto as chancellors, Sanbaonu and Leshi as grand councillors, Ba'ba as right vice director, and Wang Pi as associate administrator.
s0094.idiomatic: For the Ministry of Revenue, we request Chigai Puji and Toghto as chancellors, Sanbaonu and Leshi as grand councillors, Ba'ba as right vice director, and Wang Pi as associate administrator.

s0095.literal: One Jiang, who drew the note design, is to be made commissioner of the Note Printing Treasury.
s0095.idiomatic: One Jiang, who drew the note design, is to be made commissioner of the Note Printing Treasury.

s0097.literal: Tashihwa said: "This is a great matter; to change it so abruptly — we request further deliberation with senior ministers."

s0099.literal: That month, Jinan, Jining, Panyang, Cao, Pu, De, Gaotang, Hezhong, Jie, Jiang, Yao, Tong, and Hua prefectures suffered locusts.

s0100.literal: Eighth month, on renzi day central secretariat officials said: "Gansu Province lies remote on the frontier; within the city gold and grain are stored to supply princes' armies and horses — Shizu and Chengzong both repaired its walls.
